proposed_representation.storage_rule: If approved, use min/max only with the range meaning explicit in the condition/provenance. Do not combine with soil-only row 181 or treat it as independent of the same-site R03 study.

limitations: Table 2 preferred variants retain 27% of measured data after filtering and depend on gap filling.
Mean ± SD in Table 2 refers to flux-time-series variability, not uncertainty of the annual integrated estimate. Do not copy it into an annual-factor SD.
9.2 is an average across alternative processing estimates and is not the recommended factor.
Whole-ecosystem and soil-only fluxes cannot be summed or pooled as independent ecosystem totals.

source_verification.source_locator: Original published PDF p. 3 sampling, p. 4 units, p. 5 Results 3.1 and Figure 2 caption; accepted manuscript p. 14 results, p. 34 caption, pp. 7–9 sampling/methods.
source_verification.visual_review: Accepted manuscript pp. 14 and 34 rendered and inspected. The 36-page file has figure captions but no Figure 2 panel suitable for digitization; no exact graph-derived values or uncertainties were invented.

observations.statistic: Reported seasonal uptake flux; source precision retained; numerical SE not available here.

normalization.meaning: Dimensional daily equivalents only. Hourly-to-daily scaling assumes a representative hourly rate and does not establish a measured daily or annual mean. Source already uses CH4 mass: no 16/12 factor.

limitations: Primary forest visited once per season; secondary forest three times per season. Study design has limited temporal coverage.
Figure 2 caption says means ± SE, not SD. Primary n=25 per season; secondary wet n=76, dry n=75. Sampling text says 75 per season: preserve the discrepancy and do not infer SD using an unresolved n.
Results show secondary-forest seasonal uptake differences despite the abstract’s broad no-seasonal-variation statement; retain the source distinction.
Different forest types are different geographic sites and histories; do not interpret this as a controlled before/after effect of drainage alone.
Negative flux denotes uptake; never replace with zero or a positive emission.
Missing exact figure means or SE do not invalidate the study, but limit the precision and scope of a factor representation.
